name: Jurassic World: Chaos Theory
description: The Camp Cretaceous gang comes together to unravel a mystery when they discover a global conspiracy that brings danger to dinosaurs — and to themselves.

videos.title: Aftershock
videos.overview: Years after escaping the dangers of Isla Nublar, Darius and friends are living among dinosaurs again — all while processing a devastating loss.

videos.title: Rest Stop
videos.overview: A frightening chase fuels Ben's theory that the Nublar Six are being hunted... but by whom? Darius agrees to go to Texas.

videos.title: Down on the Ranch
videos.overview: Uninvited guests disrupt a happy reunion on Sammy's ranch. A mysterious map contains a cryptic clue from Brooklynn — but what does it mean?

videos.title: Brothers
videos.overview: The crew arrives in Colorado to warn Kenji, who's still punishing Darius about the past. Sammy and Ben leave the group to go look for Yaz.

videos.title: Halfway Home
videos.overview: Ben and Sammy make a pit stop for snacks at King Dino's Prehistoric Playland. Kenji confronts his father, who gives him an ultimatum.

videos.title: Free Fall
videos.overview: A surprised Yaz welcomes Sammy and Ben to a protected island and gives them a tour. But is it really a "dinosaur-free zone" — or too good to be true?

videos.title: That Night
videos.overview: It's a night of revelations for Kenji and Darius when a mysterious stranger tells them everything he knows. Meanwhile for the others, it's sink or swim.

videos.title: The Drop
videos.overview: Ben, Yaz and Sammy search for answers at the DPW — and find an old friend. Darius and Kenji make a shocking discovery on Brooklynn's phone.

videos.title: Into the Fog
videos.overview: Following trucks through foggy weather, the friends arrive at a warehouse packed with dinosaurs. It's a huge operation... but who's behind it?

videos.title: The End of the Beginning
videos.overview: Confusion, chaos — and a deadly confrontation. The Camp Fam's so close to solving the mystery. But first, they'll have to fight for their lives.

videos.title: Batten Down the Hatches
videos.overview: Stowed away aboard a ship stacked with dinosaurs, the Camp Cretaceous crew stays hidden from danger — until stormy weather forces a change in plans.

videos.title: The Marooned Five
videos.overview: On dry land, the gang meets a family of farmers with unusual livestock. But where in the world could they be? Ben searches for signal to confirm a hunch.

videos.title: Cl3v3rGr186
videos.overview: A series of flashbacks reveals what happened in the days leading up to Brooklynn's violent attack — and the events that occurred immediately after.

videos.title: The Adjustment
videos.overview: Brooklynn goes undercover to gather important intel about the broker. Back in Senegal, Aminata and Darius urge Zayna out of her comfort zone.

videos.title: Troubled Waters
videos.overview: Zayna leads her new friends upriver through unsettling waters. After weeks of tracking her target in Dubai, Brooklynn comes face to face with danger.

videos.title: Up the River
videos.overview: Kenji's behavior sparks concern when the friends run into trouble on the river. Brooklynn's ready to do whatever it takes to keep the Camp Fam safe.

videos.title: All Night Long
videos.overview: The friends are forced to turn back in the dark of night when they realize they've left Yaz behind... but she's definitely not alone.

videos.title: Lab Partners (1)
videos.overview: The Camp Fam follows a hidden river bend to a chicken farm crawling with secrets. Separated from the group, Ben and Kenji look for Bumpy's egg.

videos.title: Lab Partners (2)
videos.overview: Familiar events play out from a different perspective as Brooklynn makes moves to protect her friends from inside the belly of the beast.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Broken trust. Betrayal. Disbelief. Emotions run high for the Nublar Six as they reunite under extraordinary circumstances. But where will they go from here?

videos.title: Excess Baggage
videos.overview: Still reeling from the shock of seeing Brooklynn, Darius and the gang encounter a familiar face who may offer answers — or put the group in more danger.

videos.title: Villa Paradiso
videos.overview: After landing in Italy, Ben leads the way to a safe location. Darius tries to distract Kenji from worrying about Bumpy's egg.

videos.title: The Queen's Court
videos.overview: Brooklynn and Santos head to Malta to meet their new partner. Back in Italy, the friends investigate the origins of a mysterious feather.

videos.title: Fire in the Piazza
videos.overview: With a dinosaur on the loose, the Camp Fam crew pulls together to find it. Elsewhere, Santos wonders whether her allies can be trusted.

videos.title: Boiling Over
videos.overview: While Brooklynn looks for friends in Malta's black market, a divided Camp Fam debates whether to track her down — or stay behind.

videos.title: Undercover
videos.overview: The gang breaks into groups to pull off a complicated mission. A run-in at the catacombs leaves Brooklynn questioning her goals… and her methods.

videos.title: Decisions, Decisions
videos.overview: It's time to pick a side. Brooklynn turns to old friends to help take Santos down. Meanwhile, a roadblock puts some of the others in serious danger.

videos.title: No Escape
videos.overview: While Ben, Darius and Yaz wait for backup, Sammy, Kenji and Gia follow a trail of feathers back toward town. Brooklynn makes an unusual alliance.

videos.title: Active Pursuit
videos.overview: Split up and battling separate dangers, the Nublar Six rush to complete their mission and set things right. The trickiest part? Staying alive.

videos.title: Morituri Te Salutant
videos.overview: Dinosaur chaos hits the streets of Malta, sending everyone into survival mode. In the end, a deadly standoff has fateful consequences.

videos.title: Arrival
videos.overview: Brooklynn, Darius, Ben and Yaz make their way toward Biosyn HQ while Kenji and Sammy prepare to negotiate with Lewis Dodgson.

videos.title: The Maze
videos.overview: Suspicion fuels tension between Darius and Brooklynn as she works to build back the team's trust. Sammy and Kenji connect over shared family history.

videos.title: Familiar Faces
videos.overview: Kenji and Sammy fight to stay safe in the wild. Elsewhere, an angry Brooklynn confronts an old nemesis — only to be surprised by what she finds.

videos.title: Ctrl + F
videos.overview: As the crew moves from outpost to outpost in search of Dr. Wu's backup server, Yaz and Sammy get closer, and Brooklynn and Kenji attempt to clear the air.

videos.title: Give & Take
videos.overview: Things go from bad to much, much worse when a dinosaur attack on the outpost forces the team to take their chances on the run.

videos.title: Fire
videos.overview: Ben tries to stay calm — and quiet — in the wake of a perilous encounter. Later, emotions run high during a bittersweet reunion.

videos.title: How Strong We Are
videos.overview: As dangerous fires spread, Sammy and Yaz split from the group to get Bumpy and Smoothie to safety while Brooklynn and Darius search for transportation.

videos.title: Lights Out
videos.overview: A systemwide power failure complicates the team's escape. Meanwhile, panic starts to set in as Ben loses strength.

videos.title: Fare Well
videos.overview: With time running short, the determined Camp Fam digs deep to come up with a plan that could help them pull off a miracle.
